build_model_from_cfg: build a detectron2 model from a config object using the registered meta-architecture
register_meta_arch: register a new meta-architecture class in the META_ARCH_REGISTRY for model building
get_meta_arch_from_registry: get a registered meta-architecture builder by name from META_ARCH_REGISTRY
review_build_model: review the build_model function to understand how it constructs models from config
summarize_meta_arch_registry: summarize the META_ARCH_REGISTRY and how it maps names to model builders
